stem.text: 1-chloro-2-methylbutane reacts with sodium cyanide in a nucleophilic substitution reaction.
What is the most likely intermediate or transition state in this reaction?

A.alt: Transition state in square brackets with negative charge: central C bonded to NC and Cl by dashed bonds, with a hashed-wedge H, a solid-wedge H, and CH(CH3)CH2CH3 below.

B.alt: Transition state in square brackets with negative charge: central C bonded to NC and Cl by dashed bonds, with a hashed-wedge H3C, a solid-wedge CH2CH3, and CH3 below.

C.alt: Planar carbocation with a positive charge on C, bonded to H3C (hashed wedge), CH2CH3 (solid wedge) and CH3 below.

D.alt: Planar carbocation with a positive charge on C, bonded to H (hashed wedge), H (solid wedge) and CH(CH3)CH2CH3 below.
